framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the tall frame edge to edge
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright sunlit interior
character: iridescent blue-green peacock, glossy crest, long neck, silk cravat, fills two thirds of the frame
props: white marble catwalk into the lens; a giant open wallet on wheels rolling beside him, mouth gaping; two magpie stylists on his back, one with pliers, one with a receipt spool; price tags on the stripped quills
prop_continuity: fan full until 4.3; thinning from 4.3; bare quill frame with tags from 5.1; wallet in the middle of it from 9.15
motion_rule: he drives at the lens every window and never holds a pose, not even the last; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: sunlit arcade, glass roof, blurred shoppers

audio.delivery: smug preening male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: VNESH-niy, bez-u-PRE-chen, ko-SHEL-ke, TOL-ko, PER-ya
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.5
audio.lip_sync: beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: claws on marble, pliers snipping, spool ratcheting, feathers rustling

timeline.a: he bursts through a paper hoop at the lens, chest first, shreds off his crest
timeline.c: big close on his chest, whip to his face

timeline.a: he strides the catwalk straight at the lens, heavy fan dragging, both magpies riding his back
timeline.c: big close on his beak, push out

timeline.a: driving at the lens he swings his neck across frame, fan sweeping the marble
timeline.c: low tracking three quarter beside him

timeline.a: the first magpie hauls a quill from his fan and rams it at the lens into the wallet mouth
timeline.c: big close low on the quill and wallet, whip

timeline.a: he drives on and rears over the rolling wallet, neck stabbing into frame, the second magpie ratcheting the spool on his flank
timeline.c: tight frontal from below, push in

timeline.a: both magpies rip out a fistful of quills and his fan collapses to a bare frame, tags swinging on the stubs
timeline.c: mid three quarter on the thinning fan, whip

timeline.a: the wallet swerves in front of him and he vaults clean over it at the lens, bare quill frame rattling
timeline.c: low tracking under the vault into a big close, racing back

timeline.a: both magpies shove the last quills into the gaping wallet mouth at the lens
timeline.c: big close low on the wallet mouth, whip to his face

timeline.a: he drives straight at the lens and throws the bare quill frame wide open behind him, tags whipping
timeline.c: tight low frontal, hard push in

timeline.a: the wallet gapes at the lens and a storm of feathers erupts out over his face
timeline.c: big close low on the wallet mouth and his face

timeline.a: he charges through the feather storm at the lens, both magpies flung off his back
timeline.c: low tracking frontal racing back ahead of him

timeline.a: he rams the bare quill frame open into the lens, wallet swinging in the middle, and throws his head past the camera, feathers raining
timeline.c: big close low frontal on his face and the bare fan, sweeping past

must_appear: the tail fan stripped to a bare quill frame with tags; the giant wallet hanging in the middle of that bare fan; a storm of feathers erupting from the wallet mouth; both magpies working on him at the lens; his face to the lens in the final window
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, any lettering in frame, a square picture padded into a tall frame, letterbox, static camera, a static wide with him small in frame, he stands still while speaking, he holds a pose in the last window, banknotes, cash, coins, a human hand with a microphone, a full lush tail fan after 5.1, the magpies standing still, English speech, any word after 7.5
